intro:
Hello, and thank you for being here.

Buzz Connect is a Sri Lankan marketing company based in Colombo. Since 2014 we've been on a journey to help people in Sri Lanka save money and time, by sharing great offers, promotions, events and learning opportunities from some of the best companies in the country.

This page explains, in simple words, what information we use, why we use it, and how you can change or stop the messages you get from us at any time.
summary:
• We share offers and updates by email, SMS and WhatsApp.
  • We never sell your personal data. It stays safely with Buzz Connect, and only we use it.
  • Every message we send carries the Buzz Connect footer and branding, so you always know it's from us.
  • Want to stop? Email buzzunsubscribe@gmail.com or visit buzzconnect.lk/unsubscribe. We'll remove your details within 7 days.
  • Changed your mind later? You're always welcome back.

sections.heading: Who we are
sections.html:
Buzz Connect, Colombo, Sri Lanka.
Email: infobuzzconnect@gmail.com · Mobile and WhatsApp: +94 77 143 7707 · Landline: +94 11 287 7662

sections.heading: The information we use
sections.html:
We keep it simple and only use what we need:

  • Contact details: your name, email address and mobile number, and which of our lists you're on.
  • Your choices: for example, if you've asked us to stop certain messages.
  • Enquiries: what you tell us when you contact us or fill in a form on our website.
  • Website visits: basic, general information about how people use our website (see "Our website" below).

We don't ask for sensitive information such as bank details, health information or ID numbers in our messages, and we'll never ask you to share them by SMS or WhatsApp.

sections.heading: How we use it
sections.html:
• To share offers, promotions, events and learning opportunities from Sri Lankan companies that we think you'll find useful.
  • To reply when you contact us.
  • To improve our website and understand which of our advertising works.
  • To respect your choices, including remembering if you've asked us to stop.

sections.heading: Our promise about client data
sections.html: When a business shares contact details with us for its own campaigns, we use them only for that client's campaigns. We never sell client data, never share it with anyone else, and never use it for Buzz Connect's own messages without consent.

sections.heading: Your data is safe with us
sections.html:
We never sell your personal data, and we don't give it to other companies. Your details stay securely with Buzz Connect, and only Buzz Connect uses them, to send you our own messages.

To deliver those messages, we use trusted sending and hosting tools that work only on our instructions. They don't use your details for anything else. We'll only ever share information if the law requires it.

sections.heading: Every message carries our branding
sections.html:
Whenever we send you a message, it carries the Buzz Connect footer and branding. Our emails always include our footer with an "Unsubscribe" link, so you always know a message is from us and how to stop it.

If you get a message that looks like ours but doesn't carry our footer or branding, it may not be from us. Send a screenshot to buzzunsubscribe@gmail.com and we'll check for you.

sections.heading: How to stop our messages: two easy options
sections.html:
We'd love to keep sharing good offers with you, but if you'd rather not hear from us, that's completely okay. No hard feelings.

Option 1: send us an email (the easiest)
Email buzzunsubscribe@gmail.com with the email address and/or mobile number you'd like removed. If it's about an SMS or WhatsApp message, a screenshot of the message helps us find it quickly.

You can simply copy this:

To: buzzunsubscribe@gmail.com
Subject: Please unsubscribe me

Hi Buzz Connect,

Please remove me from your messages.

Email: [your email address]
Mobile: [your mobile number]
Please stop: Email / SMS / WhatsApp / All messages

Thank you.

Option 2: use our unsubscribe page
Visit buzzconnect.lk/unsubscribe, enter your email or number, and choose which messages to stop.

Also:

  • Email: every Buzz Connect email has our footer with an "Unsubscribe" link. One click and you're done.
  • WhatsApp: you can also block the number at any time.

We'll remove your contact details from our lists within 7 days. A message that was already scheduled may still arrive during that time.

Please note: sometimes other companies use sender names that look like ours. Our messages always carry the Buzz Connect footer and branding. If a message doesn't, or you're not sure it came from us, send us a screenshot and we'll check for you.

sections.heading: After you unsubscribe
sections.html: We remove your details from our sending lists. To make sure you're never added back by mistake, we keep only a small note (your email or number, and the date you asked to stop). If you'd like us to delete that note as well, just ask. Screenshots you send us are used only to handle your request and are then deleted.

sections.heading: Welcome back anytime
sections.html:
If you change your mind, the door is always open. Email infobuzzconnect@gmail.com with "Please add me back", and we'll be happy to have you with us again.

You can also discover great offers, events and learning opportunities anytime on findit.lk, with no sign-up needed.

sections.heading: Our website
sections.html:
Website and enquiry information

Our site uses Google Analytics and Google Ads tags. Enquiry buttons and forms may record the page, selected service, destination number, message and any contact details you provide so we can handle enquiries and review website activity. Opening WhatsApp does not confirm that a message was delivered.

Facebook website measurement

Where permitted, the Meta Pixel shares page visits, browser and device information, IP address and advertising cookie identifiers with Meta for advertising measurement, remarketing and optimization. We do not enable automatic form collection, customer matching or server-side Meta event uploads. Enquiry names, phone numbers and WhatsApp messages are not sent as Meta event fields.

Regional limits

We do not show a consent banner. Facebook tracking stays off for unanswered visits from the EU/EEA, UK, Switzerland and Canada, and whenever the location cannot be verified. Elsewhere it may run unless you opt out or your browser sends Global Privacy Control. Private, career, finance and healthcare pages, and visits with query strings or fragments, are excluded from Facebook tracking.

Advertising choices

You can stop Facebook tracking for this browser below. Your refusal takes effect immediately, is saved with the time and notice version, and applies to other open tabs. It does not erase information already received by Meta. This choice does not change existing Google tracking or our enquiry records. Contact us for questions about enquiry information or prior sharing.

Clearing browser storage removes this saved choice. A browser privacy signal continues to block Facebook tracking.

Lovable visitor analytics

Lovable's analytics uses no cookies, stores nothing on your device, does not keep IP addresses and does not identify visitors. Lovable collects this data for us. Lovable's privacy policy explains how it handles it.

It records pages visited, where visitors came from, country, browser, operating system and device type, time on the site, page loading speed, errors, and clicks on buttons and links. Detailed data is kept for 90 days and daily summaries for a year.

Clicks are held back until analytics is accepted for visitors in the EU/EEA, UK, Switzerland and Canada, and when location is unknown. Elsewhere they are recorded unless analytics is rejected. Clicks are never recorded when your browser sends Global Privacy Control, even if you accept. Any saved choice is kept in your browser for up to 12 months. Page visits, time on page, page speed and errors are recorded for every visitor, without cookies and without identifying anyone.

Website tools and stored choices

Google Analytics receives website usage and event information, and Google Ads receives advertising measurement information. Where browser consent permits, their tags can store analytics or advertising cookies and send browser, device, IP address and cookie information to Google. See Google's privacy policy.

Our hosting and data services receive enquiry and unsubscribe information, including screenshots you choose to attach. Administrative sign-in stores a session in the browser. The website may remember contact details you provide to enquiry forms, privacy choices and recent unsubscribe submission times in browser storage. Following a WhatsApp link opens WhatsApp, which handles your conversation under its own privacy policy. See Meta's privacy policy for information Meta receives.

sections.heading: How long we keep information
sections.html: We keep your contact details while you're on our lists, and enquiry details only for as long as we need them to help you. When you unsubscribe, we remove your details within 7 days, keeping only the small do-not-contact note described above.

sections.heading: Keeping your information safe
sections.html: We take sensible steps to protect your information and limit access to the people who need it. No system is 100% secure, but we work hard to keep your details safe.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.html:
In line with Sri Lanka's Personal Data Protection Act, No. 9 of 2022, you can ask us to:

  • tell you what personal data we hold about you;
  • correct it;
  • delete it;
  • stop using it for marketing, or withdraw your consent.

Just email infobuzzconnect@gmail.com, or buzzunsubscribe@gmail.com to stop messages, and we'll be glad to help.

sections.heading: Children
sections.html: Our messages and services are meant for adults. We don't knowingly collect information from children under 18. If you think we have, please let us know and we'll remove it.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
sections.html: We may update this page from time to time. When we do, we'll change the "Last updated" date at the top.
